# BLO-47692 — turn off Claude Code commit/PR attribution in agent sessions

Tracking: [BLO-47692](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/BLO/issues/BLO-47692)

`src/server/env-guard.ts`: the settings-merge script that already writes the
PreToolUse guard hook into `settings.json` now also sets
`attribution: {commit: "", pr: ""}` (overriding any seeded value, preserving
other `attribution` keys) and `includeCoAuthoredBy: false`. With Claude Code's
default attribution every session receives a reminder to end commits with
`Co-Authored-By: Claude …` and PRs with "Generated with [Claude Code]"; those
lines then reach `main` through squash merges.

Measured against the fleet runtime (`claude-code` 2.1.292) with `claude -p
--settings`: `{}` yields the "End git commit messages with: Co-Authored-By:
Claude …" reminder; the new settings yield none.

`src/server/env-guard.test.ts` gains one case: a seeded attribution value is
overridden and a sibling key (`sessionUrl`) survives.
